run_vox_manifest: run the VoxCeleb2 TSV preparation script to generate train.tsv files for audio and video data
run_vox_manifest_en: run the VoxCeleb2 TSV preparation script with English-only utterance IDs to filter training data
run_vox_manifest_all: run the VoxCeleb2 TSV preparation script to generate TSV files for all utterances including non-English
review_main: review the main function that parses VoxCeleb2 arguments and sets up TSV target directories
review_setup_target: review the setup_target function that writes TSV files with fid, video path, audio path, and frame counts
